description_en:
Reset the Data Service application key. Only the application owner can perform this operation.
Release version: v6.0.0
description_zh:
重置数据服务应用密钥，仅应用负责人可操作。
上线版本：v6.0.0
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public reset-data-service-app-secret --op-tenant-id 30001011 --update-command AppId=12345 AppKey=200000001 AppSecret=abc123456789 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetDataServiceAppSecret

fields.help_en:
The new application key, which must be globally unique and is used when calling APIs.
The length is 8 to 128 English characters, and can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
Customization is supported only when using Alibaba Cloud API Gateway or the built-in gateway. This configuration is ignored when using a dedicated cloud gateway
fields.help_zh:
新的应用Key，需要全局唯一，用于调用 API 时使用。
长度为8~128个英文字符，可包含数字，下划线（_）和短横线（-）
仅阿里云API网关和内置网关时，可自定义；专有云网关时，忽略该配置
fields.name: app_key

fields.help_en:
The new application secret.
If this parameter is left empty, the system automatically generates a new AppSecret value.
The length is 8 to 127 English characters, and can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
Customization is supported only when using Alibaba Cloud API Gateway or the built-in gateway. This configuration is ignored when using a dedicated cloud gateway
fields.help_zh:
新的应用密钥。
该参数不填，默认系统会自动生成一个新的 AppSecret 值
长度为8~127个英文字符，可包含数字，下划线（_）和短横线（-）。
仅阿里云API网关和内置网关时，可自定义；专有云网关时，忽略该配置
fields.name: app_secret

parameters.help_zh: 重置数据服务应用密钥
parameters.name: update_command
